name: node-installer
description: Installs and hardens a Remnawave node: firewall, Docker, HAProxy SNI routing, nginx default site, the node container and the checks.

steps.title: Node API port open to the panel only (DOCKER-USER and UFW)
nginx: SelfSNI site and default site
HAProxy: SNI routing with a default backend
Remnawave node container (guarded systemd startup; run apiacl first)
SSH: administrator account, keys, root and password login
Rename the node on this server

NODE_DOMAIN.description: Public domain name of the node: SNI, host name and SelfSNI site. Upper case is converted to lower case.

NODE_IP.description: Public IPv4 address of this server; HAProxy binds it on port 443.

NODE_PORT.description: TCP port of the node API (panel to node); not 80, 443 or 8444. Changing an existing managed port is not supported.

SECRET_KEY.description: Node secret key from the panel (the SECRET_KEY of the compose file the panel shows for the node). 16 to 8192 characters of letters, digits and + / = _ . : -. Kept only in the compose file, mode 600. Or give SECRET_KEY_FILE.

SECRET_KEY_FILE.description: Path of a file that holds the node secret key instead of SECRET_KEY: a regular file (not a link) owned by root or by the user running the installer, mode 600 or 400, one line, at most 16 KiB. Giving both is refused. Also the option --secret-file SECRET_KEY=PATH.

PANEL_ALLOW_IP.description: IPv4 addresses (space separated) that may reach the node API port: the panel. Nobody else can.

SSH_PORT.description: SSH port that the firewall keeps open. Default: the port sshd reports, else 22.

CERTSYNC_PUBKEY.description: Public key of whatever delivers certificates to /opt/certs. Installed for the user certsync, limited to rrsync in that directory (command=, restrict). Empty: the receiver is not set up and full skips it.

NODE_IMAGE_TAG.description: Explicit release tag of the remnawave/node image. Floating tags such as latest and nightly are refused. Tags are not digest pins.

FAIL2BAN_IGNORE_EXTRA.description: Extra IPv4 addresses or CIDR ranges (prefix 8 to 32, space separated) that fail2ban never bans, for example the Swellwright server.

BASE_UPGRADE.description: Run apt upgrade in the base step.

DOCKER_SOURCE.description: Docker's apt repository with a pinned signing key. The convenience script is not supported.

HAPROXY_SOURCE.description: auto: the PPA on Ubuntu, the distribution package on Debian. ppa: the vbernat PPA of HAPROXY_VERSION. distro: the distribution package.

SSH_PHASE.description: user: create the administrator and its keys. root: close the requested login methods, only with a terminal and a confirmed fresh administrator login with root access. all: both.

NEW_USER.description: Administrator account with sudo. Before root or password login is closed (SSH_PHASE=root or all) it names the administrator whose key login must work. Not root and not certsync.

NEW_USER_PUBKEY.description: Public SSH key of the administrator. Before root or password login is closed it must be a key in the key file of NEW_USER that gives a shell.

NEW_USER_PUBKEY2.description: Optional second (backup) public SSH key of the administrator.

NEW_USER_PASSWORD.description: Password of a newly created administrator (sudo needs it). Required without a terminal. Only through the environment, an env file or NEW_USER_PASSWORD_FILE, never logged.

NEW_USER_PASSWORD_FILE.description: Path of a file that holds the password of the new administrator instead of NEW_USER_PASSWORD: same rules as SECRET_KEY_FILE. Giving both is refused. Also the option --secret-file NEW_USER_PASSWORD=PATH.

SSH_DISABLE_ROOT.description: Close root login over SSH (only when an administrator can really log in: see the README, section SSH).

SSH_DISABLE_PASSWORD.description: Close password login over SSH (only when an administrator can really log in with a key). Check the key login in another window first.

RENAME_FROM.description: The former domain in the rename step. Default: the domain from the saved configuration.

RENAME_ALIAS.description: Domains (space separated) that nginx and HAProxy keep accepting besides the new one, until clients have the new name.

INSTALL_MODE.description: new: a node that is not in the panel yet. redeploy: an existing node on a new or reinstalled server (changes the closing checklist).

SW_NONINTERACTIVE.description: 1: never ask; a missing required parameter stops the run.

SW_ENV_FILE.description: File with NAME=value lines for the parameters above (the option --env-file does the same). Mode 600, owned by root.

SW_VERBOSE.description: 1: show the output of apt and docker on the screen (it always goes to the journal).

SW_ASCII.description: 1: plain ASCII symbols instead of Unicode ones.

NO_COLOR.description: Any non-empty value switches colours off (no-color.org).
